title: 电感、电容元件的相量关系
tags: 电感 VCR 相量形式
电容 VCR 相量形式
statement: u_s(t) = 100√2 cos(1000t + 30°) V 同时加在电感 L = 0.2 H 和电容 C = 10 µF 两端，电流 i_L、i_C 的参考方向如图（与电压关联）。
用有效值相量求 İ_L 的有效值和初相，以及 İ_C 的初相。

questions.ask: 若电压有效值不变、角频率提高到 2000 rad/s，两个电流有效值如何变化？
choices: I_L 变为 1 A，I_C 变为 0.5 A
I_L 变为 0.25 A，I_C 变为 2 A
questions.explain: X_L = ωL 与频率成正比，X_C = 1/(ωC) 与频率成反比：ω 加倍时 X_L = 400 Ω、X_C = 50 Ω，I_L = 0.25 A，I_C = 2 A。

hints: 先写电压相量 U̇ = 100∠30° V，再算 X_L = ωL 和 X_C = 1/(ωC)。
电感：U̇ = jωL·İ（电流滞后 90°）；电容：İ = jωC·U̇（电流超前 90°）。
solution: **5. 相量图。** 以 U̇ 为参考：İ_L 落后 U̇ 90°，İ_C 超前 U̇ 90°，两者反相；电源电流 İ_L + İ_C = 0.5∠120° A。

en.title: Phasor relations of the inductor and the capacitor
statement: u_s(t) = 100√2 cos(1000t + 30°) V is applied across both an inductor L = 0.2 H and a capacitor C = 10 µF; the reference directions of i_L and i_C are shown (passive convention).
Using rms phasors, find the rms value and initial phase of Ī_L, and the initial phase of Ī_C.

questions.explain: Ī_L = U/(jωL) = 100∠30°/(200∠90°) = 0.5∠−60° A: the inductor current lags its voltage by 90°.
Ī_C = jωC·U = (0.01∠90°)(100∠30°) = 1∠120° A: the capacitor current leads its voltage by 90°.

questions.ask: If the rms voltage stays the same but ω is raised to 2000 rad/s, what happens to the two rms currents?
choices: I_L becomes 1 A, I_C becomes 0.5 A
I_L becomes 0.25 A, I_C becomes 2 A
questions.explain: X_L = ωL grows with frequency and X_C = 1/(ωC) falls with it: at double ω, X_L = 400 Ω and X_C = 50 Ω, so I_L = 0.25 A and I_C = 2 A.

hints: Write the voltage phasor U = 100∠30° V, then compute X_L = ωL and X_C = 1/(ωC).
Inductor: U = jωL·Ī (current lags by 90°); capacitor: Ī = jωC·U (current leads by 90°).
solution: **5. Phasor diagram.** With U as reference, Ī_L is 90° behind and Ī_C 90° ahead, so they are in antiphase; the source current is Ī_L + Ī_C = 0.5∠120° A.
